<style>
/* Tanpa JS, tanpa animasi. Tiap blok = container/widget Elementor bawaan. */
.ks-komodo{--main:#0077B6;--primary:#0A77FF;--sun:#F1C40F;--ink:#192434;--body:#1B2B41;--mist:#EAF4FA;--sand:#FBF3DC;--line:#D3E3ED;--muted:#53667A}
.ks-komodo *{box-sizing:border-box}
.ks-komodo{margin:0;background:#fff;color:var(--body);font:18px/1.85 Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,Arial,sans-serif}
.ks-komodo img{max-width:100%;display:block}.ks-komodo a{color:var(--primary)}
.ks-komodo p{margin:0 0 24px}

/* header tema (bukan bagian template) */
.ks-komodo .site-header{border-bottom:1px solid #eef2f5}
.ks-komodo .bar{max-width:1280px;height:80px;margin:auto;padding:12px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.ks-komodo .site-logo{width:160px;height:auto}
.ks-komodo .nav a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;margin-left:30px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}

/* 1. Kepala artikel: breadcrumb, judul, standfirst, meta, cover */
.ks-komodo .wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
.ks-komodo .head{padding-top:40px}
.ks-komodo .crumb{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px}.ks-komodo .crumb a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none}
.ks-komodo h1{font-size:54px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-2px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 20px;max-width:900px}
.ks-komodo .stand{font-size:21px;line-height:1.65;color:#31445A;max-width:820px;margin:0 0 28px}
.ks-komodo .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px 0;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}
.ks-komodo .meta>*{padding:0 18px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.ks-komodo .meta>*:first-child{padding-left:0;border-left:0}
.ks-komodo .by{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.ks-komodo .av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--main);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.ks-komodo .meta b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.ks-komodo .cover{margin:28px 0 0}
.ks-komodo .cover img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:2/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px 20px 20px 140px}
.ks-komodo .cover figcaption{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px}

/* 2. Isi: kolom artikel 720px + kolom samping 300px */
.ks-komodo .body{display:flex;gap:64px;align-items:flex-start;padding-top:56px}
.ks-komodo .main{flex:0 1 720px;min-width:0}
.ks-komodo .side{flex:1;min-width:260px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.ks-komodo .main img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:14px}
.ks-komodo .sec{margin-top:72px;padding-top:56px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.ks-komodo .sec:first-child{margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0}
.ks-komodo h2{font-size:34px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-1px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 14px}
.ks-komodo .bar-y{width:56px;height:4px;background:var(--sun);border-radius:4px;margin:0 0 30px}
.ks-komodo h3{font-size:23px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.4px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin:44px 0 12px}
.ks-komodo h3.first{margin-top:0}
.ks-komodo .main strong{color:var(--ink)}
.ks-komodo .note{border-left:4px solid var(--sun);background:#FFFBEA;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;margin:0 0 56px}
.ks-komodo .note p{margin:0;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.7}
.ks-komodo .note b{display:block;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:2px;font-size:16px}

/* aktivitas: satu kolom, garis biru di kiri */
.ks-komodo .act{border-left:3px solid var(--main);padding-left:24px;margin:0 0 36px}
.ks-komodo .act h3{margin-top:0}
.ks-komodo .pair{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:36px 0 0;align-items:flex-end}
.ks-komodo .pair .a{flex:0 0 58%}.ks-komodo .pair .b{flex:1}.ks-komodo .pair.flip .a{flex:0 0 40%}.ks-komodo .pair.flip .b{flex:1}
.ks-komodo .pair img{aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}.ks-komodo .pair .tall img{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.ks-komodo figure{margin:40px 0 0}

/* pasang surut: dua container berdampingan */
.ks-komodo .tides{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:8px 0 28px}
.ks-komodo .tide{flex:1;border-radius:14px;padding:22px 24px}
.ks-komodo .tide.low{background:var(--sand)}.ks-komodo .tide.high{background:#E1F0FA}
.ks-komodo .tide b{display:block;font-size:19px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}
.ks-komodo .tide p{margin:0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}

/* daftar bawaan: widget Icon List */
.ks-komodo .pack{list-style:none;margin:0 0 28px;padding:0}
.ks-komodo .pack li{padding:13px 0 13px 36px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;line-height:1.6}
.ks-komodo .pack li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;top:19px;width:12px;height:7px;border-left:3px solid var(--main);border-bottom:3px solid var(--main);transform:rotate(-45deg)}

/* FAQ: widget Accordion */
.ks-komodo details{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.ks-komodo details:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ks-komodo summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:20px 44px 20px 0;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);position:relative;line-height:1.45;font-size:18px}
.ks-komodo summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.ks-komodo summary::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:4px;top:16px;font-size:28px;font-weight:400;color:var(--main);line-height:1}
.ks-komodo details[open] summary::after{content:"−"}
.ks-komodo details p{margin:0 0 22px}

/* baca berikutnya */
.ks-komodo .next{display:block;text-decoration:none;margin-top:64px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px 26px}
.ks-komodo .next small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.ks-komodo .next b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:20px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:2px}

/* kolom samping */
.ks-komodo .card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px}
.ks-komodo .card h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.3}
.ks-komodo .toc{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.ks-komodo .toc li{padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.45}.ks-komodo .toc li:last-child{border:0}
.ks-komodo .toc a{color:var(--body);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}.ks-komodo .toc a:hover{color:var(--primary)}
.ks-komodo .cta{background:var(--main);border:0;color:#fff}.ks-komodo .cta h4{color:#fff;font-size:19px}
.ks-komodo .cta p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 18px;color:#e6f3fb}
.ks-komodo .btn{display:inline-block;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--sun);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.4}
.ks-komodo .btn.blue{background:var(--main);color:#fff}

/* 3. CTA penutup */
.ks-komodo .band{background:var(--main);color:#fff;margin-top:88px}
.ks-komodo .band-in{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:68px 28px}
.ks-komodo .band p{font-size:30px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.6px;max-width:760px;margin:0 0 28px}
.ks-komodo .band small{display:block;margin-top:34px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#cfe6f4}
.ks-komodo footer{text-align:center;color:#728996;font-size:13px;padding:25px}

@media(max-width:960px){
 .ks-komodo .body{flex-direction:column;gap:48px}.ks-komodo .main{flex:none;width:100%}.ks-komodo .side{width:100%;flex:none}
 .ks-komodo h1{font-size:40px;letter-spacing:-1.4px}.ks-komodo .stand{font-size:19px}.ks-komodo .cover img{border-radius:16px 16px 16px 80px}}

settings._title: Paragraf · Komodo dragons ( Varanus komodoensis ) live n
settings.html: Komodo dragons (Varanus komodoensis) live naturally on only a handful of islands: Komodo, Rinca, Gili Motang, Gili Dasami, and parts of western Flores. Komodo Island holds the biggest population. As a result, seeing them here means seeing them truly wild, hunting deer and resting under tamarind trees.

settings._title: Paragraf · UNESCO named Komodo National Park a World Her
settings.html: UNESCO named Komodo National Park a World Heritage Site in 1991. On Komodo Island, dry savanna, rocky ridges, and monsoon forest meet the sea. Besides dragons, you may spot Timor deer, wild boar, and the rare yellow-crested cockatoo.

settings.html: Pink Beach (Pantai Merah) sits on the coast of Komodo Island. The pink color of its sand comes from tiny fragments of red organisms mixed with white sand. Just offshore, shallow reefs are home to clownfish, parrotfish, and the occasional sea turtle. Also, check the availability of the snorkeling gear provided on trips with Kapalsantai.

settings.html: Komodo dragons are wild predators. Therefore, follow these rules on every Komodo Island tour to keep yourself and the animals safe:

settings._title: Daftar bernomor · Stay With Your Ranger Never leave the group o
settings.html:
1. Stay With Your Ranger
    Never leave the group or wander off the trail.
  2. Keep Your Distance
    Stay at least 5 meters away, even when a dragon looks asleep.
  3. Tell the Ranger About Wounds
    Dragons are sensitive to the smell of blood. Let your ranger know if you have an open wound or are menstruating.
  4. No Food, No Flash
    Never feed the animals, and turn off your camera flash.

settings.html:
• April to October (dry season): Clear skies, calm seas, and dry trails. Dragons are easier to spot on the open savanna. This is also peak season, so book early.
  • November to March (rainy season): Greener hills and fewer boats, but choppier seas and slippery paths. Some trips may change route due to weather.

settings._title: Paragraf · Around the mating season in the middle of the
settings.html: Around the mating season in the middle of the year, dragons can be less visible near the main trails of a Komodo Island tour. However, your ranger will know where to look.

settings.html: All visitors on a Komodo Island tour pay a national park entrance ticket plus guide and local fees. Fees for foreign and Indonesian visitors are different and have changed several times, so always check the latest rate before you travel.

settings._title: Paragraf · Since 1 April 2026, the park limits visits to
settings.html: Since 1 April 2026, the park limits visits to 1,000 people per day, booked through the park's SiOra system. On Kapalsantai trips, our team handles permits and quota booking for you, so you can relax and enjoy the trip.

FAQ · Is it safe to visit Komodo Island? Yes, as lo
settings.html:
Is it safe to visit Komodo Island?

Yes, as long as you follow your ranger's instructions. Trained rangers accompany every group, and visitors must stay on the marked trails. Also, let the ranger know if you have an open wound or are menstruating, so they are aware of what can and cannot be done.

settings._title: FAQ · Will I definitely see a Komodo dragon? Sighti
settings.html:
Will I definitely see a Komodo dragon?

Sightings are very likely, especially in the dry season, but they are never guaranteed. After all, these are wild animals that move freely.

settings._title: FAQ · How do I get to Komodo Island from Labuan Baj
settings.html:
How do I get to Komodo Island from Labuan Bajo?

By boat only. Most travelers join a day trip or a multi-day sailing trip from Labuan Bajo. Travel time depends on the boat type and the itinerary, so check out your preferred trip on Kapalsantai.

settings._title: FAQ · Can I fly a drone on Komodo Island? Drones ne
settings.html:
Can I fly a drone on Komodo Island?

Drones need a separate permit from the park authority, so ask your operator or Kapalsantai’s customer service before your trip.
